name: @vzn/vx-dte-relay
description: The reference relay for @vzn/vx-dte: carries messages between a vx run's orchestrator and its CI agents, admitting only CI OIDC tokens of the same repository.
//: wrangler: deploys src/worker.ts by wrangler.jsonc, which the Deploy to Cloudflare button reads (it parses no other config).
@vzn/vx: vx.config.ts's core, the workspace's own here; `*`, not workspace:, which npm refuses when the button installs this directory alone.
miniflare: tests/worker-sockets.test.ts runs src/worker.ts in workerd, the runtime Workers deploy to.

REPOSITORIES.description: The repositories whose CI runs this relay carries, `owner/repo`, comma separated, such as `vznjs/vx`. A token of any other is refused.
